title: Custom engine with AI
author: Somnati
selftext: Im using Claude to convert a fork of game maker studio 2 to support modern 3d tech with vulkan/pathtracing etc...if I make a game with this engine but all the code, art and world are made by me is it still considered AI made even though AI built the 3d architecture?

comments.author: MidSerpent
comments.body:
“Is it still considered AI made?”

There are no actual real rules about this. 

Any given person is going to say yes or no depending on their perspective.

comments.author: taisui
comments.body: Why not just use Unity? Or Godot? Seems to be reinventing the wheel

replies.author: Somnati
replies.body: Because I know game maker really well and with Claude I have control over the 3d level editor and tools...also Godot and unity don't have pathtracing as far as I know.

comments.author: KnownPride
comments.body: Why that even matter. If you think being made by or not is important i think youre on wrong sub.

replies.author: Somnati
replies.body: My questions related to AI gamedev so this is the right sub

comments.author: Asleep_Stage_451
comments.body: I dunno…. It’s day 406 of me waiting for Claude to build an open world survival craft game.  Still nothing.  Maybe I should give it a prompt?  Na.  I’ll wait.  I want this to be AI made.
